title: Set up the TikTok Pixel and Events API

sections.title: Events API access token
sections.summary: In the same pixel open Settings and click Generate Access Token; copy it and paste it into the TikTok Events API integration. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
sections.verifyHint: A server event carrying ttclid appears in Events Manager → Test events.

sections.title: Pixel code from TikTok Events Manager
sections.summary: Open TikTok Events Manager, choose Web events and select your pixel: the pixel code (starts with C) is shown in the header. Paste it into the TikTok Pixel integration; the Events API integration uses the same code. Verify against the live vendor UI before publishing.
sections.verifyHint: Events Manager → Test events shows a page view from the published funnel URL.
